That is why, if you are planning on travelling on national rail services, you can request an assistance booking in advance - now up to 2 hours before your journey is due to start, any time of the day. stepFreeCategory.notes:
This is a Category B1 station. Low platform and is paved - used only in the Summer months.

Please take care when boarding / alighting the train at this station as the stepping distance between the train and the platform may be more prominent than at other stations.

requestStop.notes:
If you wish to board the train at this station, please use the Request Stop Kiosk on the platform. You must do this between 20 minutes and 5 minutes before the train is due to arrive.

If the button is not pushed at least 5 minutes before the train arrives, the train will NOT stop.
